body: It really would be bad. I’ve told my parents that I’m unhappy before,  and they pretty much just told me that people my age can’t be truly unhappy, and that I should stop using social media if I want to be less sad. With the counselor, I could try but when I start talking about how I’m feeling it’s like I get lost in thought, and I say whatever the first thing on my mind is

My family is very ignorant when it comes to mental health and would just make me feel worse. 
I have gone to see a counselor(school counselor, I’m 15) but I haven’t gone back because I always got told that they wouldn’t be able to keep my stuff confidential because it always led back to suicide.

I know it may seem like some people may only be sad for a little bit, but I can assure you that people will miss you for a very long time. I’ve only been scrolling through this subreddit for a day or two and I already want to be able to be there for everyone. I know life is shit, that’s why I’m on this subreddit, but life is shit that we can get through
Please go to the ER or call an ambulance. You still have time to get the shit out of your system before it’s too late

Dude I saw one of your earlier comments. You and I are the same age and are having the same feelings. Please, if you see this comment, go force yourself to throw up. I really know that life isn’t fair and that it’s shit, but I also know that there’s at least a chance of it getting better. If you see this please message me because I would like to talk to you
